name: Mall Ceiling Light Module
summary: Recessed 576 mm square ceiling light with an editable opal emissive diffuser, ivory bezel and metal housing.
description: Original generic recessed light cassette for modular Singapore/Malaysia mall interiors. Replaces one panel bay in ceiling kit 422 without replacing the remaining ceiling. Static emission only, no light switch or physical scene illumination.
author: Yap Wei Jun project / agent-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Original deterministic Blender Python geometry and Principled materials; no third-party models, artwork, textures or fonts.

display.origin: centre of bezel underside, with fastener heads 1 mm below

assembly.instructions: Use ceiling kit 422. Remove exactly one PANEL_1..4 child only. Keep the ceiling root, the other three panels, nine grid rails and twelve suspension meshes. Place the lamp root at that panel centre X/Z with glTF Y=ceiling root Y+0.008 m. Blender X/Y centre is +/-0.3 m, Z=ceiling root Z+0.008 m. Quarter-turn rotations are supported. Do not leave the removed panel behind the diffuser or replace the entire ceiling kit. This is visualization placement, not a certified installation.

material_notes: 11 independent closed mesh components, four editable materials. Bezel, annular tray walls, diffuser, rear plate, driver cover, four fasteners and two cable-entry glands. Static warm emissive diffuser; no exported lights, animations, wiring system, switch or photometric model.
accuracy_notes: Generic decorative ceiling light concept. Not an electrical, fire, acoustic, structural, lighting performance, installation or building-code specification. Static emissive PBR material does not illuminate neighbouring geometry in the Three.js gallery.

attribution.credit: Original geometry and materials authored for Blender-3D-Gallery; no external artwork.

rights: Original asset; reuse in the owner's projects is authorized. Public redistribution terms have not been specified.

quality_gate.scope: Local artifact only. Current gallery camera starts above the correctly oriented fixture and shows its rear; use underside orbit. Static emission stays visible without physical scene illumination. Desktop narrow viewports are not Android/iOS verification.
